title: Graphene-based C-reactive protein immunoassay with smartphone readout
protocol: Incubate the MTP well surface with 100 μL of 1% \(w/v) KOH in DIW for 10 min.
Wash the MTP wells five times with 300 μL DIW per well.
Mix EDC-activated Ab with GNPs (1 mg mL\(^{-1}\)) in 0.25% APTES in a ratio of 1:1 \(v/v).
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash the resulting Ab-bound and GNPs-functionalized MTP wells five times with 300 μL of PBST.
Block the MTP wells by incubating with 300 µL of 5% \(w/v) BSA for 30 min at 37 °C.
Wash the MTP wells with 300 µL of wash buffer five times.
Dispense 100 μL of biotinylated anti-CRP detection Ab at a concentration of 0.17 µg mL\(^-1\) to the Ab-bound and BSA-blocked MTP wells.
Incubate for 15 min at 37 °C.
Wash the resulting sandwich immune complex-bound MTP with 300 µL of PBST five times.
Add 100 µL of the TMB-H\(_2\)O\(_2\) mixture to each MTP well and incubate at RT for 4 min.
Stop the enzymatic reaction by adding 50 μL of 2N H\(_2\)SO\(_4\) to each MTP well.
Perform the colorimetric readout of the MTP by smartphone imaging using the developed SBCR setup.
Place the iPad mini in the designated groove of the base holder.
Place the 96-well MTP on the iPad mini’s screensaver, which provides white light-based bottom illumination to specific regions corresponding to the wells’ bottoms.
Put the dark box on top of the base holder into the alignment groove.
Perform imaging of the colorimetric reaction in the MTP using the Samsung SIII mini’s back camera by placing it inside the designated groove on top of the dark hood.
Determine the desired pixel intensity (PI) of the captured smartphone image using ImageJ.
Split the color channel of the image.
Identify the pixel coordinate of individual MTP well’s center using the red channel image.
Calculate a mean of neighboring pixels from the center for all channels individually.
Derive the composite mean PI (CMPI) using the formula: CMPI = 0.7 MPI\_Blue + 0.2 MPI\_Green + 0.1 MPI\_Red.
Determine the desired PI as 255 – CMPI_Test Conc – CMPI_Blank.
